title: Neon Combat Manager: Initiative Carousel, Crew HUD, Conditions, Combat Time, Weather & Visibility for Cyberpunk RED
description: An encounter overhaul for Cyberpunk RED - CORE: the Initiative Queue as a neon carousel; a crew status bar with HP, armor, LUCK, Wound States and conditions; Neon Conditions, the full Cyberpunk RED condition set wired into the system's roll modifiers, with a Condition Lab, triggers and a stand-in for Condition Lab & Triggler; Rounds that move world time 3 seconds (SmallTime and Neon Hub's calendar follow); Night City weather from Neon Hub's calendar as conditions; and visibility penalties from darkness, light sources and the gear that cuts through them.

recommends.reason: The day's Night City weather comes from Neon Hub's calendar, and its clock shows on the carousel. Combat Rounds move world time, so the calendar changes day at midnight mid-fight.
SmallTime's darkness follows world time, so the light (and the visibility penalties) change as the Rounds go by. Use SmallTime 1.24.0 on Foundry v12.
Animated and switchable lights count as light sources for visibility, like token lights (a flashlight on) and ambient lights.
Its encumbrance statuses sit in the token HUD alongside the Cyberpunk RED conditions.
